# Function for saving figures.
```{r}
save_plot = function(plot, file, legend = TRUE, width = 4, height = 4, png = FALSE) {
  if (png) { ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".png"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in') }
  ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".pdf"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in')
}

```

```{r}
net = get_collectri(organism = 'human', split_complexes = FALSE)

get_pos_targeted = function(tf) {
  targeted_genes = net %>%
    filter(source == tf) %>%
    filter(mor == 1) %>%
    pull(target) %>%
    unique()
  return(targeted_genes)
}

fosl2_genes = get_pos_targeted("FOSL2")
```

```{r}
differentiation_tfs = c("GATA1", "MYC", "SP1", "NFE2", "HDAC1", "TAF1", "MYB", "TBP", "LMO2", "TAL1", "MED1", "KMT2D", "GATA2", "JUN", "IRF1", "IRF8", "CEBPA", "ETV6")

tet2_mono_data = read_tsv("tables/metacells_de/tet2_classical_monocytes.tsv") 
dnmt3a_mono_data = read_tsv("tables/metacells_de/dnmt3a_classical_monocytes.tsv") 

for (gene in differentiation_tfs) {
  pos_targeted_genes = net %>%
    filter(source == gene & mor == 1) %>%
    pull(target) %>%
    unique()
  neg_targeted_genes = net %>%
    filter(source == gene & mor == -1) %>%
    pull(target) %>%
    unique()
  
  tet2_mono_data$target = ifelse(tet2_mono_data$gene %in% pos_targeted_genes, "Positively regulated", ifelse(tet2_mono_data$gene %in% neg_targeted_genes, "Negatively regulated", "Not regulated"))
  dnmt3a_mono_data$target = ifelse(dnmt3a_mono_data$gene %in% pos_targeted_genes, "Positively regulated", ifelse(dnmt3a_mono_data$gene %in% neg_targeted_genes, "Negatively regulated", "Not regulated"))
  
  tet2_mono_data$regulation = ifelse(tet2_mono_data$log2FoldChange > 0.25 & tet2_mono_data$padj < 0.05, "Up", ifelse(tet2_mono_data$log2FoldChange < -0.25 & tet2_mono_data$padj < 0.05, "Down", "Not significant"))
  dnmt3a_mono_data$regulation = ifelse(dnmt3a_mono_data$log2FoldChange > 0.25 & dnmt3a_mono_data$padj < 0.05, "Up", ifelse(dnmt3a_mono_data$log2FoldChange < -0.25 & dnmt3a_mono_data$padj < 0.05, "Down", "Not significant"))
  
  print(ggplot(tet2_mono_data, aes(target, fill = regulation)) +
    geom_bar(position = "fill") +
    theme_bw() +
    ggtitle(paste("TET2", gene)))
  
  print(ggplot(dnmt3a_mono_data, aes(target, fill = regulation)) +
    geom_bar(position = "fill") +
    theme_bw() +
    ggtitle(paste("DNMT3A", gene)))
  
}
```


# Plot volcanos.
```{r}

myeloid_up_genes = read_tsv("input_data/myeloid_differentiation_up.tsv", skip = 2, col_names = "gene")
myeloid_down_genes = read_tsv("input_data/myeloid_differentiation_down.tsv", skip = 2, col_names = "gene")

format_volcano = list(
  xlab("decreased in CHIP     log2(fold change)     increased in CHIP"),
  ylab("-log10(p-value)"),
  guides(color = guide_legend("Function")),
  theme_bw(),
  theme_classic(),
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        text = element_text(size = 12.5),
        title = element_text(size = 11),
        legend.key.size = unit(0, "lines")),
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#C8133BFF", "#EA8783FF", "darkgrey"))

)


# function for adding labels
gene_labels = function(data, direction, xlim, ylim, few = FALSE) {
  sorted_data = data %>% 
    arrange(desc(`-log10_p_val`)) %>%
    filter(`-log10_p_val` > -log10(0.05)) %>%
    filter(abs(log2FoldChange) > 0.25) %>%
    head(10)
  if (few) {
    sorted_data = head(sorted_data, 3)
  }
  if (direction == "pos") {
    xlims = c(xlim - xlim/3, xlim + xlim/3)
  } else {
    xlims = c(-xlim - xlim/3, -xlim + xlim/3)
  }
  labels = geom_label_repel(data = sorted_data, mapping = aes(label = gene), size = 3, fill = NA, direction = "y", max.overlaps =  Inf, nudge_x = 0.05, segment.alpha = 0.25, force_pull = 0, xlim = xlims, ylim = c(ylim / 5, ylim), show.legend = FALSE, box.padding = 0, segment.linetype = "solid", label.size = 0.08, segment.curvature = ifelse(direction == "neg", -1e-40, 1e-40))
  return(list(labels))
}

# function for making plot
make_volcano_plots = function(cell_type, comparison, x_limit = 1.5, few = FALSE, rds = FALSE, title = "", standard_y_limit = NA) {

  folder = "tables/metacells_de/"
  filename = paste0(comparison, "_", cell_type, ".tsv")
  path_to_file = paste0(folder, filename)
  
  data = read_tsv(paste0(path_to_file)) %>%
    mutate(`-log10_p_val` = -log10(padj))
  
  # sometimes the most significant p-value is 0, which results in an infinite value after log transformation
  # if that is the case, these lines convert the value to the highest possible value
  if (any(data$`-log10_p_val` == Inf)) {
    data$`-log10_p_val`[data$`-log10_p_val` == Inf] = 292
  } 
  
  y_limit = max(data$`-log10_p_val`) * 1.1
  
  data$label_group = "Other"
  data$label_group[data$gene %in% myeloid_up_genes$gene] = "Myeloid up genes"
  data$label_group[data$gene %in% myeloid_down_genes$gene] = "Myeloid down genes"
  data$label_group = factor(data$label_group, levels = c("Myeloid up genes", "Myeloid down genes", "Other"))

  data_pos = data %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 0)
  data_neg = data %>% filter(log2FoldChange < 0)
  buffer = 5
  
  highlight_list = c(myeloid_up_genes$gene, myeloid_down_genes$gene)

  data_pos = data_pos %>% filter(gene %in% c(highlight_list)) #, head(data_pos, 7) %>% pull(gene)))
  data_neg = data_neg %>% filter(gene %in% c(highlight_list)) #, head(data_neg, 7) %>% pull(gene)))
  
  title = ifelse(title == "", gsub("_", " ", gsub(".tsv", "", path_to_file)), title)
  
  # render plot
  plot = ggplot(data %>% arrange(gene %in% highlight_list), aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = `-log10_p_val`, color = label_group)) +
      geom_point() +
      format_volcano +
      xlim(-x_limit, x_limit) +
      ylim(0, ifelse(!is.na(standard_y_limit), standard_y_limit, y_limit)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.25, 0.25), linetype = "longdash", alpha = 0.5) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "longdash", alpha = 0.5) +
      gene_labels(data = data_pos, direction = "pos", xlim = x_limit, ylim = y_limit, few) +
      gene_labels(data = data_neg, direction = "neg", xlim = x_limit, ylim = y_limit, few) +
      ggtitle(title)
  
  print(plot)
  
  output_filename = paste0("figures/volcanos/", gsub(".tsv", "", gsub("\\+", "", filename)))
  save_plot(plot, output_filename, height = 4, width = 6.5, png = TRUE)
}
```
